post.title: Amazon spent $102.7B on shipping. Here's who pays.
post.ig:
Amazon spent about $103B on shipping in 2025. So who pays for free shipping?
Amazon's shipping costs rose from $76.7B in 2021 to $102.7B in 2025, per its 10-K.
Target and Walmart set a $35 free-shipping minimum for non-members.
Prime costs $139 a year and Walmart+ $98 a year (as of 2026).
Our math: topping a $28 cart up to $35 is 25% more spending.
Sources: Amazon Form 10-K filings 2021-2025, Target and Walmart shipping policies.
